title: ADRON-55 reconstruction pipeline: an open reprocessing and detector-response analysis chain for the ADRON-55 ionization calorimeter
description:
An open, scripted reconstruction pipeline for the ADRON-55 ionization calorimeter of the HADRON-55 complex at the Tien Shan high-altitude cosmic-ray station (3340 m a.s.l., 43.04° N, 76.94° E, Kazakhstan).

The pipeline takes the instrument from its raw per-section data format to calibrated three-dimensional tracks and per-plane detector-response observables. It comprises:

  • decoding of the raw .dat format and construction of an HDF5 event catalogue in a single streaming pass;
  • assembly of the overlapping chamber sections of each row into a single position profile;
  • cluster finding and veto conditions for pathological events;
  • a file-level integrity and good-run audit that flags runs with an inactive readout branch, duplicated files, and misfiled seasons;
  • a channel-to-position calibration and an iterative track-based alignment of the planes;
  • a road-search track finder confined to the hadron block, projection matching, and a weighted least-squares three-dimensional fit;
  • conversion of local arrival directions to equatorial coordinates with Astropy.

Diagnostic and figure scripts are included, so that every calibration and every figure of the accompanying paper can be reproduced from the raw data.

The raw event data of the 2021 and 2023 observing seasons are archived as a separate Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21701891).
